# SafeMath

[Git Source](https://github.com/robotmoney/robotmoney-core/blob/aae683920cd57dc96d920c3e2d788e226f098aef/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/external/SafeMath.sol)

**Title:** SafeMath

Math operations with safety checks that revert on error (overflow/underflow)

## Functions

<a id="mul-uint256-uint256"></a>

### mul

Multiplies two numbers, reverts on overflow.

```solidity
function mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| a | `uint256` | First number |
| b | `uint256` | Second number |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| &lt;none&gt; | `uint256` | Product of a and b |

<a id="sub-uint256-uint256"></a>

### sub

Subtracts two numbers, reverts on overflow (i.e. if subtrahend is greater than minuend).

```solidity
function sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| a | `uint256` | First number |
| b | `uint256` | Second number |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| &lt;none&gt; | `uint256` | Difference of a and b |

<a id="add-uint256-uint256"></a>

### add

Adds two numbers, reverts on overflow.

```solidity
function add(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| a | `uint256` | First number |
| b | `uint256` | Second number |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| &lt;none&gt; | `uint256` | Sum of a and b |

<a id="max-uint256-uint256"></a>

### max

Returns the largest of two numbers.

```solidity
function max(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| a | `uint256` | First number |
| b | `uint256` | Second number |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| &lt;none&gt; | `uint256` | Largest of a and b |
